reconstruction_summary: Reconstructed agent's V1 (their declared best/'honest finish'): recompute KS yaw-rate (v/L)*tan(delta) with canonical wheelbase L per platform (2.984 m Mach-E, 3.70 m F-150), then subtract a per-segment yaw-gyro bias equal to the mean (ks_pred - meas) over that segment's straight-line samples (|delta|<0.01); biases were not persisted so recomputed per segment from the exact recipe in tools/run_ladder.py.
notes: Agent's report declares V1 as the ship-it variant ('Honest finish is to ship V1'). Per-segment bias is recomputed on the canonical set (biases not saved by the agent); the recipe is exactly as in run_ladder.py. Segments with <=5 straight samples get zero bias (matches agent's code). Agent fitted only on Mach-E in their report; here V1 is applied across both Ford platforms per the canonical eval spec.
